notes.title: Free Content Update "Frenzy" Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Savara is getting its first free content update; read about it and take a look here.[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/fa73e16e5439bfec8dffa325d9d8903233b09871.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3021630/view/545610012180873982]This update[/url] ushers in a new weapon and a new category of blessings for even more variety in battle.
 
[h2]New Weapons to Destroy Them All: Spears[/h2]

If you haven't yet found your perfect weapon, we have news that should delight warriors searching for mobility! With spears, discover a new way of fighting and their unique and divinely efficient tactics against opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/4833a79e07f9bab49ce536aae17ad1ea2bafec0b.gif[/img]
 
Aim with precision and break different parts of the monsters standing in your way. Exploit their weaknesses and do even more damage by hitting 'em where it hurts!
 
[h3]How to Equip and Use a Spear[/h3]

To equip a spear in one of Savara's weapon slots, simply head to the blacksmith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/7f0c36e1360e3ff6e980677c22659d483f90fc6b.jpg[/img]
There, you can examine your new favorite weapons – their specific details, variants, and looks!
 
[h3]A Collector's Skin for Even More Style[/h3]

A little extra bonus has slipped into the "Legacy of the Heavens" collector's edition of Savara. It would be a shame to head into battle with a new weapon that didn't go with the rest of your outfit. Owners of the collector's edition can get this gift from Iop for free and give their spear a brand-new appearance.
 
[h2]New Category of Blessings Available: Frenzy[/h2]
 
Hit fast to hit harder to hit even FASTER! When Frenzy takes hold of Savara, nothing can stop her!
This new category of blessing introduces a full 30 variants to wake your inner Iop.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/67ae93b9b0c7f16e3cd51ee838a378db4c0c1ca6.jpg[/img]
 
With Frenzy, kick up your gameplay a notch and make your battles even more epic and intense than they already were.
 
[b][h3]Check Out This Free Update Now![/h3][/b]
[i]What? Why are you still here? Jump into the fray![/i]

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/b29ea2aeb597fcd39f2746dc34c3ea110a341a08.png[/img]

[h1]Patch-note MAJ 1.1.0[/h1]


[h2]Content[/h2]
New Blessing Family : Frenzy
[list]
[*] Prioritize sustained attack and speed !
[/list]
New Weapon : The Spear
[list]
[*] It is now craftable at the blacksmith. Go try its moveset !
[/list]
[h2]Savara[/h2]
Added attack buffer at the end of roll animation.
Updated Okarus Armor description.
Updated description of Cracked Black Dofus badge.


[h2]Rogue-lite[/h2]
Increased max Prestige level from 100 to 120.
Removed the possibility to only have one door available after a fight (aside from the merchant room & rest area).
Updated multiple blessings description.
Fixed duo blessing Lightning-Judgment “Unlimited Conductivity”.
Fixed Icons passive applicator Devotion & Judgment.


[h2]Monster[/h2]
Fixed Rhinobuto gliding after being tired or stunned.
Added burn effect to Gargoylar enrage version of firebreath.


[h2]Interface[/h2]
Fixed missing tooltip in badges windows.
Fixed missing tooltip in skill windows.


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed Prestige 50 -> 100 that did not apply the health and damage modifier properly to monsters
Fixed shadows odd behaviours when using low graphics quality.
Fixed an issue preventing from using a second controller after using one.
Fixed Insectile Ring base effect giving 25% more damage instead of 20%.
Fixed Insectile Ring processing stamina as percentage rather than as absolute number.
Fixed some foes swapped in codex entries.
Fixed an issue preventing some bleed blessings from displaying their tooltips.
Fixed Savara sliding after being knocked back while being knocked down.
Fixed some blessings description.
Fixed darkened stairs in merchant room on floor 1.
Fixed minor bug on Poultragon Sword and Shield color customization.

[From patch 1.0.8]
Fixed passive applicators when player is hit.
Fixed duo aftershock/lightning triggering inconsistently.
Fixed new save crash.

notes.title: Savara Has Set Its Release Date!
notes.notes:
After thousands of battles fought and monsters sliced and diced in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126730/Savara_Demo/]playable demo during the recent Steam Next Fest[/url], it's time for Savara – and the god Iop's festival – to announce a release date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/ae02b4123cdd7461c2863aaad5e28ec38d22f6d9.jpg[/img]

That's news that's bound to delight all fans of frantic fights and strategic challenges!
Doryah Games and Ankama Games are happy to announce that Savara, the all-new rogue-lite action game, will be released officially on [b][u]May 6, 2025.[/u][/b] 

Iop has granted you a short reprieve to ready your weapons and prepare your minds before a lengthy, combat-filled odyssey begins. Patience isn't Savara's strong suit, but don't worry – there are only a few more weeks to wait before you can walk the halls of your favorite divinity's palace.

[h2]A Digital Digital Collector's Edition: "Legacy of the Heavens"[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184311/83979494b7256bc0b4dc88fb519b11ae1538e839.jpg[/img]

Because a crowd chanting your name isn't necessarily enough, the greatest fighters will delight in a digital collector's edition: "Legacy of the Heavens".
This prestigious version will include the base game Savara plus:
[list]
[*] an exclusive cosmetic arsenal of weapon and armor skins, for unflagging elegance;
[*] an original story told in a webtoon covering Savara's and the other competitors' origins; and
[*] an enchanting soundtrack composed specifically for the adventure.
[/list]
A playable demo is already available for Iop's eager adepts. Enjoy it now!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126730/Savara_Demo/

[h3][b]Rise to the ultimate challenge with us on May 6, 2025, and add your name to the legend![/b][/h3]
